translation: Zhang Jiegu said: Qiao means nimble and quick. The two vessels rise from the foot and make a person nimble and quick. The Yang Qiao is above the muscles, [where] the yang vessels travel, penetrating through the six fu and taking charge of all the exterior, and so it is named the luo of the Yang Qiao; the Yin Qiao is below the muscles, [where] the yin vessels travel, penetrating through the five zang and taking charge of all the interior, and so it is named the luo of the Yin Qiao.
